The closure review (lanes/REVIEW-pf1-l2a-898e598.md, MINOR 1) and the Lane-orchestrator's ruling on it: the two door conditions that read beyond the history (a no-records take re-run without the driver's producer-bound refusal record, a forged pin block) live in batch.door_rule_problems, which the door, every restart (Batch.run, through Batch.ruling_door_problems and the repo's driver_refusal_record or takes'), and the publication (run.produce, with a refusal argument for tests) all call; RULING_RULE's text says so; tests/test_batch.py's restart helper takes a refusal reader, and its driver-raised test re-runs only on one. Its two NITs are recorded with no change. The Lane-orchestrator's ruling on the pin-block gap (Sat 24 Oct 2026, under Javier's standing delegation), recorded as theirs: run.require_registered_outcome stays strict for every counted outcome; run.produce exempts only the pin blocks check_results.pin_block_events admits (Batch._route's block, whose appending commit is the take road's, takes.outcome_committed_by_take_road with TAKE_COMMIT_SUBJECT, drive.py's COMMIT_SUBJECT; a later outcome of the slot under the registered pin; a re-running ruling that passed the ruling rule), returns them as harness_events, and result.py (lane w5b-cp5-pipeline's entry) lists them, never counted (check_results.render_harness_events); a pin block never so re-run refuses, its message naming a stop that needs an owner.
